Checklist for physical verification of documents 
(Verification to be held at the venue of the programme) 
• 
Proof of date of birth (original for inspection; self-attested photocopy for the record). 
• 
Copy of payment receipt (seat acceptance deposit, Library caution deposit, medical insurance 
premium, etc.) [In the form of Screenshot of the portal payment page]. 
• 
Certificate(s) and mark sheet(s) establishing academic eligibility condition (original for 
inspection; self-attested photocopy for the record). See next page for details. For result 
awaited candidates, see the following notice  
https://admission.isical.ac.in/Documents/IsiAdmission2026/Submission-of-Marksheet-2026.pdf

Four stamp-size (3.5 x 2.5 cm) colour photographs. 
•

(The Medical Certificate should be duly signed, stamped and registration number clearly 
mentioned by the Certifying Medical Practitioner.) Valid special certificates (if applicable): 
▪ Appropriate category certificate for candidates seeking admission under SC/ST or 
OBC-NCL category. 
▪ EWS certificate for candidates seeking admission under GEN-EWS category. 
▪ PwBD certificate for candidates seeking admission under PwBD category. 
▪ Domicile certificate for candidates seeking admission to PGDSMA (Domicile) 
programme. 
• 
Work related certificate/undertaking (if applicable): 
▪ For sponsored candidates: Certificate from sponsoring organization, certifying that 
the candidate has been in service for at least two years (starting after the date of 
candidate acquiring the qualifying degree), and undertaking that the organization

the candidate has been in service for at least two years (starting after the date of 
candidate acquiring the qualifying degree), and undertaking that the organization 
will pay the candidate’s tuition fees and will allow relieve the candidate to pursue 
the programme for its full duration. 
▪ For employed candidates on academic leave: Declaration from employer indicating 
leave to permit full-time availability of the candidate for the duration of the 
academic programme. 
▪ For all other candidates: Declaration / Undertaking of non-employment. 
• 
Declaration / Undertaking of full-time academic engagement. 
• 
Undertaking of non-ragging by the candidate (and guardian for candidates below eighteen 
years of age). 
• 
Submit the Filled-up account form (third page in the account form) for transferring stipend / 
fellowship/other deposits and also submit a xerox copy of passbook (first page where name

of account holder (student), account number, IFSC code, branch name etc. are mentioned), 
OR xerox copy of a cancelled bank cheque. The account form is available here  
https://admission.isical.ac.in/Documents/IsiAdmission2026/Account-Form-Stipend-and-Fellowship-2026.pdf

INDIAN STATISTICAL INSTITUTE 
KOLKATA /DELHI/BANGALORE/CHENNAI/TEZPUR/GIRIDIH 
DECLARATION/UNDERTAKING OF FULL-TIME ACADEMIC ENGAGEMENT 
(to be filled at the time of admission) 
I hereby declare that I am not currently enrolled in a full-time or part-time academic programme at 
any other institution. I also undertake that I shall not enroll in any other full-time or part-time 
academic programme at any other institution before completing or resigning from the programme. 
If the above declaration is found to be false or if I am found guilty of violation of the above 
undertaking, I understand that my status as student/research fellow of ISI will be summarily 
terminated, and I shall have to refund all the stipend/fellowship received from the Institute.

DECLARATION/UNDERTAKING OF NON-EMPLOYMENT 
(to be filled at the time of admission) 
I hereby declare that I am not currently engaged in a full-time or part-time job at any organization. I 
also undertake that I shall not take up any full-time or part-time job (e.g., as paid instructor in 
coaching businesses, or as provider of help in homework/ projects/ examinations through online 
businesses) before completing (or resigning from) the programme. If the above declaration is found 
to be false or if I am found guilty of violation of the above undertaking, I understand that my status 
as student/research fellow of ISI will be summarily terminated and I shall have to refund all the 
stipend/fellowship received from the Institute.
